name: Fx

form_factor.comment: Native terminal CLI with an experimental WebAssembly embedding SDK and an ACP server. Per-form-factor links: CLI: https://fx.sh/docs/getting-started/install; SDK: https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx/tree/main/sdk.

released_in.comment: Fx's first public stable release line is dated August 2026.

latest_major_update.comment: Fx v0.0.11 shipped September 24, 2026 with stable custom OpenAI-compatible connections, custom themes, launch-time provider, model, effort, and fast controls, Slack bot management, image reading, expanded libfx controls, much faster resume and lookup, and sharply lower memory use on long turns.

pricing.value: Apache-2.0 CLI; model-provider usage is billed separately
pricing.comment: The harness is open source. Model access uses Vercel AI Gateway, ChatGPT or Grok subscriptions, or configured local or OpenAI-compatible inference.

some_free_usage.comment: The reviewed public sources do not establish a bundled free model allowance.

no_account_required.comment: Preview custom connections can use anonymous local inference, while built-in cloud providers require authentication.

can_use_other_subscriptions.comment: Fx supports ChatGPT and Grok subscription sign-in, Vercel AI Gateway, and configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

rules.comment: Fx loads scoped project instruction files and related workspace context.

hooks.comment: No public lifecycle-hook contract was established in the reviewed Fx documentation.

mcp_servers.comment: Fx connects external tools through MCP and provides interactive management and health diagnostics.

custom_commands.comment: Fx provides an extensive built-in slash-command surface; a user-defined custom-command format was not established.

goal_command.comment: No first-party persistent /goal command is documented.

subagents.comment: Fx supports one-off and named session-backed subagents with inherited permission restrictions.

monitor.comment: Fx can list and inspect background commands, but the reviewed sources do not establish a general event-driven monitor primitive.

transcripts.comment: Location: Fx saves session transcripts under `~/.fx/sessions/`; they can be listed, inspected as JSON, resumed, migrated, and recovered.

transcript_location.value: Per-workspace saved sessions; exact path undocumented
transcript_location.comment: Location: Fx saves session transcripts under `~/.fx/sessions/`; they can be listed, inspected as JSON, resumed, migrated, and recovered.

model_selection.comment: Fx saves a model per provider and supports `--provider`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--fast` for interactive sessions; `fx ask` accepts model, effort, and fast overrides for a single run.

approval_mode.comment: Permission modes include ask, automatic review, and explicit full-access bypass, with remembered allow, ask, and deny rules.

sandbox_mode.comment: Fx enforces permission checks and command safety controls, but the reviewed stable documentation does not establish a configurable filesystem or network sandbox mode.

resume.comment: Supports latest-session and exact-session resume flows in both interactive and headless modes.

continue.comment: Fx v0.0.11 removed `/continue`; transient failures now retry and continue automatically. Session selection and resume remain available through `/resume`.

non_interactive.comment: `fx ask` runs one request and exits, with argument or stdin prompts for scripts and CI.

output_format.comment: `fx ask --json` returns one structured result object with output, final output, exit code, session, model, usage, and tool-call fields.

statusline.comment: The status line can independently show context, session, and workspace information.

telemetry.comment: Fx documents an opt-out for local Herdr lifecycle reporting, but the reviewed public sources do not establish a complete product telemetry contract.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: Interactive Fx documents keyboard shortcuts for editing, interruption, pickers, transcript review, and navigation.

theme_customization.comment: Fx follows terminal light or dark mode, ships built-in themes, and loads custom VS Code-format JSON themes from `~/.fx/themes/`.

auto_save.comment: Fx automatically saves workspace sessions for inspection, resume, recovery, and compaction.

debugging_output.comment: `fx status`, `fx doctor`, and `/trace` provide configuration, preflight, and private diagnostic output.

context_window.comment: Fx exposes configurable context-input limits and model metadata for automatic compaction budgets.

code_formatting.comment: No dedicated built-in formatter or linter integration was established.

git_integration.comment: Fx exposes pull-request and issue workflows and works in Git repositories; a dedicated branch and diff-management UI was not established.

performance_mode.comment: Fx is a small native Zig binary with measured startup and turn-performance work, but no separate stable user-facing performance mode was established.

ui_customization.comment: Fx supports theme, grouped-tool-call, status-line, notification, slash-menu, and startup-scrollback preferences, but not arbitrary panel layout.

hosted_agent.comment: Fx is a local native CLI; model access may be local or cloud, but the harness itself is not a hosted workspace.

custom_model_provider.comment: Fx supports named OpenAI Chat Completions connections for local servers and other gateways, configured in `~/.fx/settings.json` and selected with `fx provider`, `--provider`, or `FX_PROVIDER`.

notes: Fx is Vercel Labs' experimental Unix-like native coding-agent CLI and embeddable harness. Fx 0.0.10 was previously installed locally from the official setup script; this run verified v0.0.11 from the official release metadata but did not replace the existing binary.
